seo-slop.description: SEO Slop orchestrator — coordinates SEO audits, research, and strategy across 8 specialist subagents. Use for any SEO workflow: audits, keyword research, content strategy, schema, backlinks, local SEO, Google APIs, vault management.

seo-technical.description: Technical SEO specialist: crawlability, indexability, meta tags, performance (CWV), sitemaps, hreflang, security headers, JS rendering.

seo-content.description: Content & strategy specialist: E-E-A-T analysis, brand positioning, BEAST planning, FLOW framework, content briefs, topic clustering, programmatic SEO.

seo-keywords.description: Keywords & SERP specialist: keyword research (volume, difficulty, intent), SERP analysis, SXO scoring, competitor comparison page generation.

seo-backlinks.description: Backlinks & off-page specialist: domain authority, anchor text distribution, toxic-link detection, CommonCrawl and Bing fallback.

seo-schema.description: Schema & structured data specialist: JSON-LD detection, validation, and generation against Schema.org standards. Gates for deprecated types.

seo-local.description: Local & maps specialist: Google Business Profile, NAP consistency, citations, geo-grid rankings, GEO/AI-search readiness, e-commerce SEO.

seo-google.description: Google APIs specialist: PageSpeed Insights, CrUX history, Search Console queries, GA4 reporting, image audit, drift monitoring.

seo-vault.description: Vault health specialist: schema drift linting, dead wikilinks, unresolved tokens, evidence thresholds, archival snapshots, brain review for hallucinations.
